summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (tests, mypy, black) per instructions, and no commit was made. Formatting was checked by hand against the 88-character limit.
